segments.name: Financials Services
products: Market making and fixed income investments
segments.description: Provides retail brokerage, investment advisory, insurance, corporate services and related financial services to retail and institutional clients.
segments.evidence: We operate and manage our business as two reportable segments: Financials Services and Media, Sports and Entertainment.

segments.name: Media, Sports and Entertainment
products: Management and promotion of sports and music talent
segments.description: Manages and promotes sports and music talent and provides in-house production and marketing for the Company.
segments.evidence: Gebbia Media, LLC ("GM") is a Florida limited liability company and provides management and promotion of sports and music talent, as well as in-house production and marketing for the Company.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay the Company brokerage commissions, advisory fees, insurance-related fees and fees for execution, margin financing and corporate equity services.
revenueModel.evidence: MSCO also offers customers execution services through various market centers for an additional fee, providing customers access to numerous market centers before and after regular market hours.

changes.text: In recent years the Company added a Media, Sports and Entertainment segment through its acquisition of a media and entertainment company, Gebbia Media, LLC.
changes.evidence: As part of our strategic initiatives to diversify and create synergies between our enterprises, we acquired a media and entertainment company.
